reason: A verification toolkit primarily focused on claim checking, configuration validation, and read-only URL, npm, and GitHub probes.

summaries.zh: 用于核验工作区中的声明、检查 JSON/YAML 配置，并执行 URL、npm 与 GitHub 的只读探测。

Performs read-only HTTP, npm registry, and GitHub repository probes
